name: smolagents
summary: smolagents is a small Python library from Hugging Face for agents that write their actions as Python code. Its CodeAgent logic fits in about 1,000 lines, it works with any LLM (local transformers, Ollama, Hub inference providers or LiteLLM) and it can run generated code in sandboxes such as E2B, Modal, Blaxel or Docker.
facts: Tools can be loaded from MCP servers
E2B, Modal, Blaxel or Docker executors
goodFor: Learning how agent loops work from small code
Code-acting agents for multi-step tool use
Sharing tools and agents via the Hugging Face Hub
watchOut: Generated code must be sandboxed for safety
